name: pure-gpu-transient-lbvh-builder

builder.dynamic_input: GPU current-frame triangle generation from the exact F001 moving-rigid target subset; diagnostic sizes repeat that immutable template with deterministic page-spaced offsets
builder.page_key: 30-bit Morton, 10 bits per page coordinate axis
builder.local_morton: 30-bit Morton, 10 bits per local coordinate axis
builder.topology: Karras binary LBVH over sorted page/local keys
builder.bounds: leaf initialization plus atomic bottom-up internal bounds

representative_count: derived by reproducing the frozen F001/I001 moving-instance selection
